title: Prediction of exercise sudden death in rabbit exhaustive swimming using deep neural network.
summary: A deep neural network classified heart-sound frames from rabbit exhaustive-swimming experiments and was compared with CNN/GRU baselines; the paper reports predictive performance for an animal exercise-sudden-death model, not human clinical validation.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s computer science dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
